class.name: PorchlightAction
class.brief_description: Completes or removes one or more Porchlight milestones.
class.description: A reusable action that changes persistent milestone state through [PorchlightProgress]. [member target_mode] determines whether the action operates on the single [member milestone] or every entry in [member milestones]. [member operation] determines whether those targets are completed or removed. [method execute] processes multiple targets in their configured order and returns [code]true[/code] when at least one target changes persistent progress.

method.name: execute
method.description: Performs the configured [member operation] on each target selected by [member target_mode]. In [constant TARGET_SINGLE] mode, [member milestone] is processed once. In [constant TARGET_MULTIPLE] mode, every normalized entry in [member milestones] is processed in array order. Emits [signal executed] once for every attempted target. Returns [code]true[/code] when at least one target changes persistent milestone state. Returns [code]false[/code] when the action is invalid, every target is already in the requested state, or the [PorchlightProgress] singleton is unavailable.

method.name: get_description
method.description: Returns a readable description of the configured operation and its active targets. Invalid single-target actions return [code]No milestone selected.[/code]. Invalid multiple-target actions return [code]No milestones selected.[/code].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether this action contains the target data required by its current [member target_mode]. [constant TARGET_SINGLE] requires a nonempty [member milestone]. [constant TARGET_MULTIPLE] requires at least one normalized entry in [member milestones].

members.member: The milestone changed in [constant TARGET_SINGLE] mode. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed when assigned. This property is ignored by [constant TARGET_MULTIPLE].

The ordered milestones changed in [constant TARGET_MULTIPLE] mode. Assigned entries are trimmed, empty entries are removed, and duplicate names are discarded while preserving their first occurrence. This property is ignored by [constant TARGET_SINGLE].
The progress operation performed on every active target by [method execute].
Determines whether [method execute] uses [member milestone] or [member milestones]. Changing this property updates the Inspector without clearing the inactive target values.

signal.name: executed
signal.description: Emitted after the configured operation is attempted on [param milestone]. In [constant TARGET_MULTIPLE] mode, this signal is emitted once per target in configured order. [param changed] is [code]true[/code] only when that individual target changed persistent milestone state.

constants.constant: Completes every active target when [method execute] is called.
Removes every active target when [method execute] is called.
Uses the single [member milestone] as the action target.
Uses every normalized entry in [member milestones] as an ordered action target.
